name: Glacial Wind
body:
School evocation [air, cold]; Level druid/shaman 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Effect 60-ft. line of blasted cold
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell creates a severe, freezing blast of air (approximately 50 mph) that originates from you, affecting all creatures in a 60-ft. line. All creatures in this area suffer 1d4 hp cold damage per caster level (maximum 10d4) and are staggered for one round. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the staggered condition. This spell acts in all other ways like a gust of wind.
